title: Component Voice and Token Translation Lab: Unifying Console Widgets
creator: Avery Chen
description: Objective: Create a small experimental 'translation lab' that maps the Console's existing visual voice (spacing, elevation, motion) into a tight set of tokenized primitives and component variants that can be published as a Figma library and a QA checklist for engineering. This ticket focuses on: 1) defining a compact token surface for compact panels/cards used across Cost Explorer, Rollouts, and Metrics dashboards, 2) mapping component voice (tone, emphasis, affordance) to explicit variant states, and 3) producing a migration guide and acceptance checklist for frontend consumption. Rationale: multiple console surfaces diverged in padding, elevation, and CTA treatment during rapid feature work. This creates visual noise and inconsistent perceived latency/cost emphasis. Scope: audit 18 representative widget examples (dashboards + rollout rails + cost-summary cards), propose 6 core tokens (spacing small/medium/large, elevation low/medium, accent scale), deliver Figma library file, interactive prototype, export-ready token JSON, and an engineering QA checklist.
